# Bundled PDF libraries

- jsPDF 3.0.4: https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF/tree/v3.0.4 — MIT; see `jspdf.LICENSE`. Additional bundled dependency notices remain in `jspdf.umd.min.js`.
- html-to-image 1.11.13: https://github.com/bubkoo/html-to-image/tree/v1.11.13 — MIT; see `html-to-image.LICENSE`.

Both scripts are bundled locally so PDF generation does not require a CDN. Japanese web fonts use the Google Fonts stylesheet referenced by `index.html`, with system serif/sans-serif fallbacks when unavailable.
